title: Cardea intake batch line, v1
description: One line of the body the Cardea sink POSTs to the platform (specs/0005-cardea-sink-functional.md, Delivery contract). The body is gzip-compressed (`Content-Encoding: gzip`) newline-delimited JSON (`Content-Type: application/x-ndjson`): each line is one object matching this schema, in increasing `seq` order. The sender's instance identity travels in the `X-Cardea-Instance` header, not in the line, and the tenant is never in the payload: the platform derives it from the API key. The platform orders and deduplicates by (instance identity, seq). Unknown properties are allowed.

seq.description: The record's number within its Gateway instance: starts at 1, no number skipped. A record lost before delivery still uses its number, so a gap marks lost records and a repeated number marks a duplicate. A restarted Gateway has a new instance identity and starts again at 1.

record.description: The trace record, exactly as the Gateway produced it (a `request` or a `response` record).
